634.title: Diagnosis screens: the invoice queue, the menu with prices and the printable margin report
humanItems: The partner (a working consultant) builds a diagnosis from his own client's invoices and menu and reads the report: the numbers match what he knows, and the page prints on A4 without cut columns.
Dandan drops three invoice files: he is asked to approve them one at a time, and can skip one.
